_comment: One file per technology. The lead's HubSpot `technology` picks the file, `title` picks the entry. Both are HubSpot dropdowns, so matching is exact. `description` and `involves` are BACKGROUND the model reads, not text copied into the email.
_sourced: Researched 18 Sep 2026 from Salesforce official material (Trailhead role pages, credential pages, exam guides on help.salesforce.com, developer.salesforce.com), live 2026 postings on Dice/Indeed/ZipRecruiter, and SalesforceBen/ApexHours. See docs/STEPS.md step 8a for the corrections this turned up - several are things a practitioner would notice if we got them wrong.

Salesforce Developer.description: Writes Apex classes and triggers, builds Lightning Web Components, and configures Flow automation against business requirements. Runs unit tests, debugs in sandboxes, and builds REST integrations to outside systems, working in sprints alongside admins and analysts.

Salesforce Lead Developer.description: Sets the technical design for a Salesforce build and reviews the team's Apex and LWC as much as writing it. Owns integration architecture, governor limits, coding standards and the release process, estimates work, and unblocks the developers building alongside.

Salesforce Architect.description: Designs the data model, security model and integration patterns for large orgs, then decides what gets solved with configuration and what needs Apex. Sets governance and deployment standards, and stays hands-on reviewing other people's builds.

Salesforce Administrator.description: Manages user access and permission sets, builds automation in Flow, and keeps data clean and reportable. Gathers requirements from business teams, builds reports and dashboards, and tests and rolls out each seasonal release.
involves: permission sets and permission set groups

Salesforce Cloud.description: Builds and runs customer messaging in Marketing Cloud Engagement: audience segmentation with SQL against data extensions, email templates, and multi-step journeys. Day to day is personalisation scripting, deliverability checks and debugging failed sends.

Salesforce Consultant.description: Runs discovery with stakeholders, turns requirements into user stories, and configures Salesforce declaratively. On CPQ work that extends to product bundles, price and product rules, discount schedules and quote templates, plus UAT and user training.

Salesforce Business Analyst.description: Sits between business stakeholders and the build team: discovery sessions, current and future-state process maps, user stories with acceptance criteria, and UAT. Most also configure reports, flows and fields themselves rather than only documenting.
involves: agile delivery in Jira or Azure DevOps

Salesforce QA.description: Tests Salesforce orgs against business requirements - functional and regression runs across configuration and custom code, integration and API checks, and permission validation. Builds automated regression suites and re-tests before each seasonal release.
involves: test plan and test case design
CI/CD integration with Copado or Jenkins
